definition: A neuroimaging finding characterized by the progressive wasting, volume loss, or degeneration of cerebellar tissue, which in the context of GTPBP2-associated Jaberi-Elahi syndrome (MIM #617988) represents a hallmark structural brain abnormality frequently co-occurring with corpus callosum hypogenesis or hypoplasia and developmental disability.

source.title: Clinical delineation of GTPBP2‐associated neuro‐ectodermal syndrome: Report of two new families and review of the literature
source.quote: had profound developmental disability with cerebellar atrophy and hypogenesis of the … variants in GTPBP2. This condition is listed in OMIM (MIM 617988) as Jaberi-Elahi syndrome.
